Herlev Hospital is a Danish healthcare organization recognized for its exceptional performance and leadership in acute surgery outcomes. Within the national quality development strategy for acute surgery—which encompasses clinical databases, governance mechanisms, and programs like LKT Akut Kirurgi—Herlev Hospital has emerged as a leading institution for quality improvement and mortality reduction [^src1]. 

Specifically, in evaluations of [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] (30-day mortality), Herlev Hospital is identified alongside Hvidovre Hospital as a "best practice" unit [^src1]. The hospital has demonstrated exceptionally good results over time regarding mortality rates, serving as a model for national knowledge sharing and continuous quality improvement across the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. This recognition highlights the hospital's successful clinical execution and its central role in the broader political and evaluative discussions on adjusting development goals and sharing best practices in acute surgical care [^src1].
